detail.longDescription:
Conduit is an open-source, native mobile client for Open WebUI, direct model endpoints, and self-hosted agents. Your chats live on your device first. Nothing routes through a backend the maintainer operates.

Three ways to connect
- Open WebUI — your self-hosted server with chats, folders, notes, channels, workspace, tools, web search, and image generation
- Direct — OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, OpenRouter, and local endpoints. No Open WebUI account required
- Hermes — your self-hosted agent with live tools, approvals for sensitive steps, and scheduled work

Built for mobile
- Real-time streaming chat with model selection, temporary chats, search, and folders
- File, image, audio, and clipboard uploads for multimodal prompts
- Voice input, voice-call mode, share sheet, quick actions, and home screen widgets
- Rich rendering for Markdown, code, LaTeX, Mermaid, Chart.js, citations, reasoning, and tool calls
- Notes, saved prompts, channels, terminal, and other features when your server supports them
- Light, dark, and system themes with secure credential storage (Keystore)

Built for real deployments
- Sign in with username/password, LDAP, JWT, OAuth/SSO, reverse-proxy flows, and custom HTTP headers
- No ads, no analytics SDKs, and no developer-operated relay server

Requirements
- Conduit does not host models or provide an AI service. You connect to servers and providers you control.
- Available features depend on what you connect to.

Permissions
- Microphone: Voice input
- Camera and Photos/Storage: Image/file attachments
- Network: Connect to your servers and providers

Open Source
Conduit is open source. For support, issues, or source code:
https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit
